title: Virgin Birth of Christ
definition: The virgin birth of Christ is the doctrine that Jesus was conceived by the Holy Spirit and born of the virgin Mary.
summary: Jesus' birth was a miraculous act of God, fulfilling Scripture and revealing Him as the holy Son of God.
christFocus: The virgin birth points to Christ's divine origin, true humanity, sinlessness, and saving mission.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The virgin birth shows that the coming of Christ is God's work. Jesus was truly born of Mary, making Him truly human, yet He was conceived by the Holy Spirit, revealing divine initiative and holiness.

This doctrine guards the identity of Christ. He is not merely another child of Adam in the ordinary way. He is the holy Son of God sent into the world.

The virgin birth also fulfills Scripture and announces that salvation comes from God, not from human strength.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people dismiss the virgin birth as unnecessary or impossible. This doctrine matters because it protects the biblical witness to who Jesus is and how God acted to save.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive the birth of Christ with wonder and faith. Let the miracle of His coming strengthen your confidence that salvation is God's work from beginning to end.
